fr.R: « Je vous ai dit que c’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} », a répondu Jésus. « Si c’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} que vous voulez, laissez partir ces hommes. »

sw.L: Yesu alijibu, "Niliwaambia kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ndiye. Basi kama ni {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} mnayenitafuta, waruhusuni hawa waondoke."
sw.B: Yesu akajibu, "Nimekwisha kuwaambia kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ndiye. Basi kama mnayemtafuta ni {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, waacheni watu hawa waende."
sw.R: "Niliwaambia kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ndiye," Yesu akajibu. "Kama mnanitaka {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, waacheni watu hawa waende zao."

vi.L: Đức Giê-xu đáp: "Ta đã nói với các người rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là [người đó]. Vậy nếu các người tìm {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, hãy để những [người] này đi."
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu trả lời: "Ta đã nói với các người rằng chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đây. Vậy nếu các người tìm {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, thì hãy để những người này đi."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu trả lời: "Ta đã nói với các người là {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đây. Nếu các người tìm {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, thì hãy để những người này đi."

ko.L: 예수께서 대답하셨다. "내가 [그 사람]이라고 너희에게 말하였다. 그러니 너희가 나를 찾는다면, 이 [사람들은] 가게 하여라."
ko.B: 예수께서 대답하셨다. "내가 그 사람이라고 너희에게 말하지 않았느냐. 너희가 찾는 사람이 나라면, 이 사람들은 가게 내버려 두어라."
ko.R: 예수께서 대답하셨다. "내가 바로 그 사람이라고 말하지 않았느냐? 너희가 찾는 사람이 나라면, 이 사람들은 보내 주어라."

pt.L: Jesus respondeu: "Eu lhes disse que eu sou. Se, pois, vocês procuram a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, deixem estes irem embora."
pt.B: Jesus respondeu: "Eu já lhes disse que sou eu. Então, se é a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} que vocês procuram, deixem estes homens irem embora."
pt.R: "Eu disse a vocês que sou eu", Jesus respondeu. "Se é a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} que vocês querem, deixem estes homens irem embora."

am.L: ኢየሱስ እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰ፦ «እኔ ነኝ ብዬ ነገርኋችሁ፤ እንግዲህ እኔን የምትፈልጉ ከሆነ እነዚህን ተዉአቸው፤ ይሂዱ።»
am.B: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ ሲል መለሰ፦ «እኔ ነኝ ብዬ ነግሬአችኋለሁ። እንግዲህ የምትፈልጉት እኔን ከሆነ እነዚህ ሰዎች ይሂዱ፤ ተዉአቸው።»
am.R: «እኔ ነኝ ብዬ ነገርኋችሁ» ብሎ ኢየሱስ መለሰላቸው። «የምትፈልጉት እኔን ከሆነ እነዚህን ሰዎች ልቀቋቸው።»

hi.L: यीशु ने उत्तर दिया, "मैंने तुमसे कहा कि मैं [वही] हूँ। इसलिए यदि तुम मुझे ढूँढ़ते हो, तो इन्हें जाने दो।"
hi.B: यीशु ने उत्तर दिया, "मैं तुमसे कह चुका हूँ कि मैं वही हूँ। इसलिए यदि तुम मुझे ही ढूँढ़ रहे हो, तो इन लोगों को जाने दो।"
hi.R: "मैंने तुमसे कहा न कि मैं वही हूँ," यीशु ने जवाब दिया। "अगर तुम्हें मेरी तलाश है, तो इन लोगों को जाने दो।"

ru.L: Иисус ответил: «Я сказал вам, что это {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}. Итак, если {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} ищете, позвольте этим уйти.»
ru.B: Иисус ответил: «Я уже сказал вам, что это {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}. Так что если вы ищете {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, отпустите этих людей.»
ru.R: «Я сказал вам, что это {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}», — ответил Иисус. «Если вам нужен {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, отпустите этих людей.»

uk.L: Відповів Ісус: «Я сказав вам, що [це] {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}. Тож якщо {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}} шукаєте, дайте цим відійти.»
uk.B: Ісус відповів: «Я вже сказав вам, що це {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}. Тож якщо ви шукаєте {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}}, відпустіть цих людей.»
uk.R: «Я сказав вам, що це {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}», — відповів Ісус. — «Якщо вам потрібен {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, відпустіть цих людей.»

ja.L: イエスは答えられた。「わたしである、とあなたがたに言った。だから、わたしを捜しているのなら、この者たちを去らせなさい。」
ja.B: イエスはお答えになった。「わたしである、と言ったではないか。わたしを捜しているのなら、この人たちは去らせなさい。」
ja.R: 「わたしである、と言ったではないか」とイエスは答えられました。「わたしを捜しているのなら、この人たちは行かせなさい。」

id.L: Yesus menjawab, "Aku telah berkata kepada kalian, {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} ini; jadi jika {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} yang kalian cari, biarkanlah mereka ini pergi."
id.B: Yesus menjawab, "Sudah {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} katakan kepada kalian, {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} ini. Jadi, kalau {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} yang kalian cari, biarkanlah orang-orang ini pergi."
id.R: "Sudah {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} katakan kepada kalian, {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} ini," jawab Yesus. "Kalau {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} yang kalian cari, biarkan orang-orang ini pergi."

zh.L: 耶稣回答说：“我已经告诉你们，我就是[{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}]。所以你们若是找我，就让这些[人]离去吧。”
zh.B: 耶稣回答：“我已经告诉过你们，我就是。既然你们要找的是我，就让这些人走吧。”
zh.R: “我告诉过你们，我就是，”耶稣回答，“如果你们要的是我，就让这些人走吧。”

ar.L: أجاب يسوع: «قلت لكم إنّي أنا هو. فإن كنتم إيّاي تطلبون، فدعوا هؤلاء ينصرفون».
ar.B: فأجاب يسوع: «قد أخبرتكم أنّي أنا هو. فإن كنتم تبحثون عنّي أنا، فاتركوا هؤلاء يذهبون».
ar.R: فأجاب يسوع: «قلت لكم إنّي أنا هو. إن كنت أنا الذي تريدونه، فدعوا هؤلاء الرجال يذهبون».

fa.L: عیسی پاسخ داد: «به شما گفتم که من [همان] هستم. پس اگر مرا می‌جویید، بگذارید اینان بروند.»
fa.B: عیسی پاسخ داد: «به شما گفتم که من همان هستم. پس اگر به دنبال من هستید، بگذارید این مردان بروند.»
fa.R: عیسی پاسخ داد: «به شما گفتم که من همان هستم.» و افزود: «اگر مرا می‌خواهید، بگذارید این مردان بروند.»

pa.L: ਯਿਸੂ ਨੇ ਉੱਤਰ ਦਿੱਤਾ, "ਮੈਂ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਕਹਿ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਕਿ ਮੈਂ [ਉਹੀ] ਹਾਂ। ਸੋ ਜੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਲੱਭਦੇ ਹੋ, ਤਾਂ ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਚਲੇ ਜਾਣ ਦਿਓ।"
pa.B: ਯਿਸੂ ਨੇ ਜਵਾਬ ਦਿੱਤਾ, "ਮੈਂ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਦੱਸ ਚੁੱਕਾ ਹਾਂ ਕਿ ਮੈਂ ਉਹੀ ਹਾਂ। ਸੋ ਜੇ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਭਾਲ ਹੈ, ਤਾਂ ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਬੰਦਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਜਾਣ ਦਿਓ।"
pa.R: ਯਿਸੂ ਨੇ ਕਿਹਾ, "ਮੈਂ ਦੱਸ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਮੈਂ ਉਹੀ ਹਾਂ। ਜੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਫੜਨ ਆਏ ਹੋ, ਤਾਂ ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਛੱਡ ਦਿਓ।"

decisions.choice: I am: as in verses 5 and 6; here the plain sense is clear from what follows
decisions.reason: See meaning decision m1 at 18:5. "If you are seeking me" shows that "I am" answered their question: he is the Jesus of Nazareth they seek. The third time, after the men have fallen, the words still carry the echo John has drawn out.

decisions.choice: me ... these: Jesus gives himself up so that his disciples go free
decisions.reason: The pronoun "me" is written out and put first for emphasis, set against "these", the disciples. As the good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep and does not leave them to the wolf (10:11-12), Jesus hands himself over and asks for his disciples' safety.

decisions.choice: let these go away: a demand, spoken as one in command of the scene
decisions.reason: The verb is an imperative, "allow them to go". Jesus, the one being arrested, tells the arresting party what to do, and the disciples are not taken (verse 9).

decisions.choice: I am [he] (L), I am he (B, R); these [men] (L), these men (B, R); if it is me (B); If I am the one you want (R)
decisions.reason: "I am he" as at verse 5 (rendering decision r-en-1 there). "These" is masculine plural and means the disciples, so "men" is supplied, in brackets at Literal. Balanced and Readable bring out the stress on "me" (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: a mí me buscan (L); si es a mí a quien buscan (B); me buscan a mí (R); estos (L), estos hombres (B, R)
decisions.reason: Each level brings out the stressed "me" set against "these" (meaning decision m2). Spanish "estos" is masculine plural like the Greek, so Literal needs no bracketed word; Balanced and Readable add "hombres" for clarity. "Yo soy" as in verse 5.

decisions.choice: hawa, without a bracketed noun
decisions.reason: The English Literal supplies "[men]" because "these" alone is unclear in English. Swahili "hawa" is already the plural for people, so nothing needs to be supplied at Literal; Balanced and Readable say "watu hawa".

decisions.choice: que sou eu (B, R); que eu sou (L)
decisions.reason: In reported speech "eu lhes disse que eu sou" reads oddly in Portuguese. Here the plain sense is clear from what follows (meaning decision m1), so Balanced and Readable say "que sou eu" ("that it is I"); Literal keeps the words of verses 5 and 6.

decisions.choice: "этих людей" (B, R); "этим" (L)
decisions.reason: Russian "этим" can stand alone for persons, so Literal needs no bracket; Balanced and Readable say "these men" as the English does (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: "わたしを……この人たちは" with は on "these" (B, R)
alternatives: "この人たちを去らせなさい"
decisions.reason: The Greek sets "me" against "these" (m2). The contrastive は on "this group" brings out that Jesus gives himself up so that they go free.

decisions.choice: "إيّاي" (L), "عنّي أنا" (B), "أنا الذي" (R); imperative "فدعوا" / "فاتركوا"
decisions.reason: Jesus gives himself up so that his disciples go free (m2): "me" is stressed against "these". "Let these go" is a demand, spoken as one in command of the scene (m3).

source.text: ἵνα πληρωθῇ ὁ λόγος ὃν εἶπεν ὅτι Οὓς δέδωκάς μοι οὐκ ἀπώλεσα ἐξ αὐτῶν οὐδένα.

records.literal_gloss: So that might be fulfilled the word which he said, "Whom you have given to me, not I lost of them not one."

en.L: [This was] so that the word which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had said might be fulfilled, "Those whom {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have given {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, I did not lose one of them."
en.B: This was so that {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own word would be fulfilled: "I have not lost a single one of those {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} gave {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
en.R: This happened so that what Jesus had said would come true: "I have not lost even one of the people {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} gave {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."

es.L: [Esto fue] para que se cumpliera la palabra que había dicho: «Los que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} has dado, no perdí de ellos ni uno».
es.B: Esto fue para que se cumpliera {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propia palabra: «No he perdido ni a uno solo de los que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} has dado».
es.R: Esto pasó para que se cumpliera lo que Jesús había dicho: «No he perdido ni a uno de los que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} diste».

fr.L: [C’était] afin que soit accomplie la parole qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait dite : « Ceux que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as donnés, je n’ai perdu aucun d’entre eux. »
fr.B: Cela arriva pour que s’accomplisse {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} propre parole : « Je n’ai perdu aucun de ceux que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as donnés. »
fr.R: Cela est arrivé pour que se réalise ce que Jésus avait dit : « Je n’ai perdu aucun de ceux que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as donnés, pas même un seul. »

sw.L: [Haya yalikuwa] ili neno alilokuwa amesema litimie: "Wale ambao umenipa, sikupoteza hata mmoja kati yao."
sw.B: Hii ilikuwa ili neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} litimie: "Sijampoteza hata mmoja wa wale ulionipa."
sw.R: Jambo hili lilitokea ili yale ambayo Yesu alikuwa amesema yatimie: "Sijampoteza hata mmoja wa watu ulionipa."

vi.L: [Việc này xảy ra] để lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nói được ứng nghiệm: "Những người Cha đã ban cho Con, Con không để mất một ai trong họ."
vi.B: Điều này xảy ra để chính lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nói được ứng nghiệm: "Trong những người Cha đã ban cho Con, Con không để mất một ai."
vi.R: Việc này xảy ra để lời Đức Giê-xu đã nói trở thành sự thật: "Con không để mất một ai trong những người Cha đã ban cho Con."

ko.L: [이는] 그분이 "아버지께서 저에게 주신 자들 가운데 저는 하나도 잃지 않았습니다" 하고 하신 말씀이 이루어지게 하려는 것이었다.
ko.B: 이것은 "아버지께서 저에게 주신 사람들 가운데 저는 하나도 잃지 않았습니다" 하신 그분의 말씀이 이루어지게 하려는 것이었다.
ko.R: 이렇게 해서 예수께서 전에 하신 말씀이 이루어졌다. "아버지께서 저에게 주신 사람들 가운데 저는 한 사람도 잃지 않았습니다."

pt.L: [Isso foi] para que se cumprisse a palavra que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tinha dito: "Dos que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} deste, não perdi nenhum."
pt.B: Isso aconteceu para que se cumprisse a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} própria palavra: "Não perdi nenhum daqueles que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} deste."
pt.R: Isso aconteceu para que se cumprisse o que Jesus tinha dito: "Não perdi nem uma das pessoas que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} deste."

am.L: [ይህ የሆነው] «ከሰጠኸኝ ከእነርሱ አንድም አላጠፋሁም» ብሎ የተናገረው ቃል እንዲፈጸም ነው።
am.B: ይህም የሆነው፦ «ከሰጠኸኝ አንዱንም አላጠፋሁም» ብሎ ራሱ የተናገረው ቃል እንዲፈጸም ነው።
am.R: ይህም የሆነው ኢየሱስ፦ «ከሰጠኸኝ ሰዎች አንድ እንኳ አላጠፋሁም» ብሎ የተናገረው ቃል እውን እንዲሆን ነው።

hi.L: [यह इसलिए हुआ] ताकि वह वचन पूरा हो जो उन्होंने कहा था, "जिन्हें तूने मुझे दिया है, उनमें से मैंने एक को भी नहीं खोया।"
hi.B: यह इसलिए हुआ कि उनका अपना कहा हुआ वचन पूरा हो: "जिन्हें तूने मुझे दिया, उनमें से मैंने एक को भी नहीं खोया।"
hi.R: यह इसलिए हुआ कि यीशु की कही हुई बात सच हो: "जो लोग तूने मुझे दिए, उनमें से मैंने एक को भी नहीं खोया।"

ru.L: [Это было,] чтобы исполнилось слово, которое {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сказал: «Из тех, кого {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} дал, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не потерял ни одного.»
ru.B: Так исполнилось {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} собственное слово: «Я не потерял ни одного из тех, кого {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} дал {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}.»
ru.R: Так сбылись слова Иисуса: «Я не потерял ни одного из тех людей, кого {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} дал {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}.»

uk.L: [Це сталося], щоб здійснилося слово, яке {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} сказав: «З тих, кого {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} дав {{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}}, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не втратив жодного.»
uk.B: Так мало здійснитися {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} власне слово: «Я не втратив жодного з тих, кого {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} дав {{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}}.»
uk.R: Так сталося, щоб збулося те, що сказав Ісус: «Я не втратив жодного з людей, яких {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} дав {{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}}.»

ja.L: [これは]、イエスが言われた言葉が成就するためであった。「あなたがわたしに与えてくださった者たちのうち、わたしは一人も失わなかった。」
ja.B: それは、「あなたがわたしにくださった人々のうち、わたしは一人も失わなかった」と言われたイエスの言葉が実現するためであった。
ja.R: これは、イエスが言われたことが本当になるためでした。「あなたがくださった人たちを、わたしは一人も失わなかった。」

id.L: [Hal ini terjadi] supaya genaplah perkataan yang telah dikatakan-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}, "Dari mereka yang {{deity_pronoun:engkau|Engkau}} berikan kepada-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}, tidak seorang pun yang {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} biarkan hilang."
id.B: Hal itu terjadi supaya genaplah perkataan-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} sendiri: "Tidak seorang pun dari mereka yang {{deity_pronoun:engkau|Engkau}} berikan kepada-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} biarkan hilang."
id.R: Hal itu terjadi supaya apa yang telah dikatakan Yesus menjadi kenyataan: "Tidak seorang pun dari orang-orang yang {{deity_pronoun:kau|Kau}}berikan kepada-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} hilang."

zh.L: [这是]为了使{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}说过的话得以应验：“{{deity_pronoun:你|祢}}赐给我的人，他们中间我没有失去一个。”
zh.B: 这是要应验{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}自己说过的话：“{{deity_pronoun:你|祢}}赐给我的人，我一个也没有失去。”
zh.R: 这件事的发生，是要让耶稣说过的话成真：“{{deity_pronoun:你|祢}}给我的人，我连一个也没有失去。”

ar.L: وذلك لتتمّ الكلمة التي قالها: «الذين وهبتهم لي ما أضعت منهم واحدًا».
ar.B: وحدث هذا لكي يتمّ القول الذي قاله: «لم أُضِع أحدًا من الذين أعطيتني إيّاهم».
ar.R: وحدث هذا لكي يتحقّق ما قاله يسوع: «لم أخسر حتّى واحدًا من الناس الذين أعطيتهم لي».

fa.L: [چنین شد] تا سخنی که گفته بود به انجام رسد: «از کسانی که به من داده‌ای، هیچ‌یک را از دست ندادم.»
fa.B: این چنین شد تا سخن خود او به انجام رسد: «از کسانی که به من دادی، حتی یکی را از دست نداده‌ام.»
fa.R: این روی داد تا آنچه عیسی گفته بود به حقیقت بپیوندد: «حتی یکی از کسانی را که به من دادی از دست نداده‌ام.»

pa.L: [ਇਹ ਇਸ ਲਈ ਹੋਇਆ] ਕਿ ਉਹ ਬਚਨ ਪੂਰਾ ਹੋਵੇ ਜੋ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਕਿਹਾ ਸੀ, "ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਹੈ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਮੈਂ ਇੱਕ ਨੂੰ ਵੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਗੁਆਇਆ।"
pa.B: ਇਹ ਇਸ ਲਈ ਹੋਇਆ ਤਾਂ ਜੋ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਕਿਹਾ ਹੋਇਆ ਬਚਨ ਪੂਰਾ ਹੋਵੇ: "ਜਿਹੜੇ ਤੂੰ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਸੌਂਪੇ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਮੈਂ ਇੱਕ ਵੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਗੁਆਇਆ।"
pa.R: ਇਹ ਇਸ ਲਈ ਹੋਇਆ ਕਿ ਯਿਸੂ ਦੀ ਕਹੀ ਹੋਈ ਗੱਲ ਸੱਚ ਸਾਬਤ ਹੋਵੇ: "ਜਿਹੜੇ ਲੋਕ ਤੂੰ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਦਿੱਤੇ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਮੈਂ ਇੱਕ ਨੂੰ ਵੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਖੋਇਆ।"

decisions.choice: so that ... might be fulfilled: John's comment on why the disciples went free
decisions.reason: The sentence is the narrator's, not Jesus's. It hangs on verse 8: Jesus asked that his disciples be let go, and they were, so that his own word came true.

decisions.choice: the word he had said: 17:12, and the promise of 6:39 and 10:28
decisions.reason: John quotes freely what Jesus said in his prayer: "I guarded them, and not one of them was lost" (17:12), echoing 6:39, "that I should lose nothing of all that he has given me". "Fulfilled" is the word John uses for Scripture coming true (12:38; 13:18; 17:12; 19:24, 36); here he uses it of Jesus's own word, as again in 18:32.

decisions.choice: I did not lose one: their safety at the arrest is part of Jesus's keeping of them
alternatives: only their physical safety that night
only their eternal safety, with no reference to that night
decisions.reason: In 6:39 and 17:12 not losing them means keeping them for eternal life. John applies the words to their escape from arrest. The two belong together: had the disciples been arrested with him that night, they might not have held out, as Peter's denials show (18:17, 25-27); Jesus keeps them in body so that they are kept for the life he promised.

decisions.choice: [This was] (L); This was so that his own word (B); This happened ... Jesus (R); lose / lost (every level)
alternatives: so that the word might be fulfilled (with no subject)
decisions.reason: English needs a subject for the purpose clause, supplied in brackets at Literal. Readable names Jesus, since the "he" could be misread, and says "come true" for "be fulfilled". Every level uses "lose", as at 6:39 and in the Balanced and Readable text of 17:12, so the reader hears the earlier word. The "you" is the Father and "me" is Jesus, so both take the deity_pronoun setting.

decisions.choice: [Esto fue] (L); Esto fue, Esto pasó (B, R); Jesús (R); perder at every level
decisions.reason: Spanish needs a subject for the purpose clause, in brackets at Literal. Readable names Jesus. Every level keeps "perder", the verb of 6:39 and 17:12 (meaning decision m2). The pronouns for the Father here are only verb endings; "me" and "su" for Jesus take the deity pronoun setting (1:1).

decisions.choice: Cha ... Con in the quoted saying
decisions.reason: The words quoted are from Jesus's prayer to the Father (17:12), so they keep the "Cha" and "Con" of John 17.

decisions.choice: The quoted words keep the formal polite style (합쇼체) and 저 of Jesus's prayer
decisions.reason: The words quoted are from the prayer to the Father (17:12), which Korean gives in 합쇼체; quoting them the same way keeps the link.

decisions.choice: "አላጠፋሁም" (I did not lose) at every level
decisions.reason: The verb is from the same root as "አልጠፋም" (was not lost) in 17:12, the saying John points back to, so the reader can hear the link in Amharic too.

decisions.choice: "तूने" in the quoted saying
decisions.reason: The words quoted are from Jesus's prayer to the Father (17:12), so they keep the address of that prayer, तू (style guide, section 4).

decisions.choice: "Так исполнилось" (B); "Так сбылись" (R)
decisions.reason: Russian can say the fulfilment as a plain statement, so Balanced and Readable avoid the heavy purpose clause; Literal keeps it, with the supplied words in brackets.

decisions.choice: "与えてくださった" (L), "くださった" (B, R) and "失わなかった", as in Jesus's prayer in 17:12
decisions.reason: John quotes the prayer of chapter 17 (m2), so the words keep the prayer's Japanese: the Son speaking to the Father with くださる for the gift.

decisions.choice: the quoted word in «» after "قالها" / "قاله"
decisions.reason: The word he had said is 17:12, with the promise of 6:39 and 10:28 (m2): their safety at the arrest is part of Jesus's keeping of them (m3). John gives the sense rather than the exact words, so the Arabic does not copy 17:12.

decisions.choice: "داده‌ای", "دادی": the singular to the Father in the quoted saying
decisions.reason: John quotes Jesus's prayer of 17:12, so the address to God stays تو.

decisions.choice: "ਤੂੰ" in the quoted saying
decisions.reason: Jesus is addressing the Father; prayers to God use ਤੂੰ.

source.text: Σίμων οὖν Πέτρος ἔχων μάχαιραν εἵλκυσεν αὐτὴν καὶ ἔπαισεν τὸν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως δοῦλον καὶ ἀπέκοψεν αὐτοῦ τὸ ὠτάριον τὸ δεξιόν.

en.L: So Simon Peter, having a sword, drew it and struck the slave of the high priest and cut off his right ear.
en.B: Simon Peter had a sword. He pulled it out and struck the high priest's servant, slicing off his right ear.
en.R: Simon Peter had a sword with him. He pulled it out and swung it at the high priest's servant. It cut off the man's right ear.

es.L: Simón Pedro, pues, teniendo una espada, la sacó e hirió al esclavo del sumo sacerdote y le cortó la oreja derecha.
es.B: Simón Pedro tenía una espada. La sacó y, de un golpe, le cortó la oreja derecha al siervo del sumo sacerdote.
es.R: Simón Pedro llevaba una espada. La sacó y le tiró un golpe al siervo del sumo sacerdote. La espada le cortó la oreja derecha.

fr.L: Simon Pierre donc, ayant une épée, la tira et frappa l’esclave du grand prêtre et lui coupa l’oreille droite.
fr.B: Simon Pierre avait une épée. Il la tira, frappa le serviteur du grand prêtre et lui trancha l’oreille droite.
fr.R: Simon Pierre avait une épée avec lui. Il l’a sortie et l’a abattue sur le serviteur du grand prêtre. L’épée a coupé l’oreille droite de cet homme.

sw.L: Basi Simoni Petro, akiwa na upanga, aliuchomoa na kumpiga mtumwa wa kuhani mkuu, na kulikata sikio lake la kulia.
sw.B: Simoni Petro alikuwa na upanga. Aliuchomoa, akamshambulia mtumishi wa kuhani mkuu na kumkata sikio la kulia.
sw.R: Simoni Petro alikuwa na upanga. Akauchomoa, akampiga nao mtumishi wa kuhani mkuu. Upanga ukamkata yule mtu sikio lake la kulia.

ko.L: 그러자 시몬 베드로가 칼을 가지고 있었는데, 그것을 빼어 대제사장의 종을 쳐서 그의 오른쪽 귀를 잘라 버렸다.

ko.R: 시몬 베드로는 칼을 하나 가지고 있었다. 그는 칼을 빼서 대제사장의 종에게 휘둘렀다. 그 칼에 그 사람의 오른쪽 귀가 잘려 나갔다.

pt.L: Simão Pedro, então, tendo uma espada, desembainhou-a e feriu o escravo do sumo sacerdote e lhe cortou a orelha direita.
pt.B: Simão Pedro tinha uma espada. Ele a puxou e golpeou o servo do sumo sacerdote, cortando-lhe a orelha direita.
pt.R: Simão Pedro tinha uma espada com ele. Ele puxou a espada e golpeou o servo do sumo sacerdote. A espada cortou a orelha direita do homem.

ru.R: У Симона Петра был с собой меч. Он выхватил его и замахнулся на раба первосвященника. Меч отрубил этому человеку правое ухо.

ja.L: すると、シモン・ペトロは剣を持っていたので、それを抜いて大祭司の奴隷に切りかかり、その右の耳を切り落とした。
ja.B: シモン・ペトロは剣を持っていた。彼はそれを抜いて大祭司のしもべに切りかかり、その右の耳を切り落とした。
ja.R: シモン・ペトロは剣を持っていました。ペトロはそれを抜いて、大祭司のしもべに切りつけました。剣はその人の右の耳を切り落としました。

id.R: Simon Petrus membawa sebilah pedang. Dia menghunusnya dan mengayunkannya kepada hamba imam besar. Telinga kanan orang itu putus.

zh.B: 西门彼得带着一把刀。他拔出刀来，向大祭司的仆人砍去，削掉了他的右耳。
zh.R: 西门彼得身上带着一把刀。他把刀拔出来，向大祭司的仆人挥去，砍掉了那人的右耳。

ar.L: ثمّ إنّ سمعان بطرس، وكان عنده سيف، سحبه وضرب به عبد رئيس الكهنة فبتر أذنه اليمنى.
ar.B: وكان مع سمعان بطرس سيف، فاستلّه وضرب خادم رئيس الكهنة، فقطع أذنه اليمنى.
ar.R: وكان سمعان بطرس يحمل سيفًا. فأخرجه وضرب به خادم رئيس الكهنة. فقطع السيف أذن الرجل اليمنى.

fa.B: شمعون پطرس شمشیری داشت. آن را کشید و بر خادم کاهن اعظم زد و گوش راستش را برید.
fa.R: شمعون پطرس شمشیری با خود داشت. آن را بیرون کشید و به سوی خادم کاهن اعظم حمله برد. شمشیر گوش راست آن مرد را برید.

pa.L: ਤਦ ਸ਼ਮਊਨ ਪਤਰਸ ਨੇ, ਜਿਸ ਕੋਲ ਤਲਵਾਰ ਸੀ, ਉਹ ਧੂਹ ਕੇ ਮਹਾਂ ਜਾਜਕ ਦੇ ਦਾਸ ਨੂੰ ਮਾਰੀ ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਸੱਜਾ ਕੰਨ ਵੱਢ ਸੁੱਟਿਆ।
pa.B: ਸ਼ਮਊਨ ਪਤਰਸ ਕੋਲ ਇੱਕ ਤਲਵਾਰ ਸੀ। ਉਸ ਨੇ ਉਹ ਕੱਢੀ ਅਤੇ ਮਹਾਂ ਜਾਜਕ ਦੇ ਦਾਸ ਉੱਤੇ ਵਾਰ ਕਰਕੇ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਸੱਜਾ ਕੰਨ ਲਾਹ ਦਿੱਤਾ।
pa.R: ਸ਼ਮਊਨ ਪਤਰਸ ਦੇ ਕੋਲ ਤਲਵਾਰ ਸੀ। ਉਸ ਨੇ ਤਲਵਾਰ ਕੱਢ ਕੇ ਮਹਾਂ ਜਾਜਕ ਦੇ ਦਾਸ ਉੱਤੇ ਚਲਾਈ। ਉਸ ਬੰਦੇ ਦਾ ਸੱਜਾ ਕੰਨ ਕੱਟਿਆ ਗਿਆ।

decisions.choice: a sword: a short sword or long knife carried for protection
alternatives: a large knife for cutting food
decisions.reason: The word is used of a short sword or a large knife. Men traveling at night might carry one; Luke records that the disciples had two (Luke 22:38). Peter draws it to defend Jesus, against what Jesus has just done in giving himself up (verse 8).

decisions.choice: the high priest's slave: a slave of Caiaphas's household, sent with the arresting party
decisions.reason: The word means a slave, a person owned by another. A high priest's slave might hold a trusted place in his household and act for his master, as this one seems to have done in the arrest. The high priest that year was Caiaphas (verse 13). Another slave of the household, a relative of this man, will recognize Peter (18:26).

decisions.choice: his right ear: all four Gospels tell of it; John alone names Peter and the slave
decisions.reason: Matthew, Mark and Luke each tell that one of those with Jesus cut off the ear of the high priest's slave (Matthew 26:51; Mark 14:47; Luke 22:50). Luke and John say it was the right ear, and Luke adds that Jesus healed it (Luke 22:51). The word for ear is a small form of the usual word, but in the speech of the time it meant simply the ear; it need not mean only the lobe.

decisions.choice: servant
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable, as the style guide has it; the meaning decision (m2) keeps that the person was owned, and Literal keeps "slave".

decisions.choice: Simon Peter had a sword. He pulled it out ... (B, R); swung it at (R)
alternatives: having a sword, drew it and struck (Literal)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable break the participle into short sentences, as English tells an action. Readable says "swung it at" for "struck", since the blow cut off an ear rather than wounding him elsewhere.

decisions.choice: esclavo (L); siervo (B, R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide rendering, as at 13:16 and 15:15; meaning decision m2 keeps that the man was owned. Balanced and Readable break the participle into short sentences, as Spanish tells an action.

decisions.choice: l’esclave (L); le serviteur (B, R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide choice for this word: Literal keeps "esclave"; Balanced and Readable say "serviteur", as the English says "servant", since the man's place in the household, not slavery itself, is the point here (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: 종 for doulos at every level
decisions.reason: The guide keeps 종 for doulos throughout; it covers a household slave or servant without the harsher 노예.

decisions.choice: "ባሪያ" (slave) at every level; also 18:10b
alternatives: "አገልጋይ" (servant), as the English Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The style guide keeps "ባሪያ" for the Greek word at every level, as Matthew 26:51 does in the same scene; "አገልጋይ" is kept for where only service is the point.

decisions.choice: "दास" (every level)
decisions.reason: The English Balanced and Readable say "servant"; the Hindi style guide keeps "दास" for doulos at every level (sections 6 and 7b), and "दास" is the plain word for a household slave of the high priest (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: "раб" at every level
decisions.reason: The style guide keeps "раб" for doulos at every level, as Matthew 26:51 and Luke 22:50 do, where the English Balanced and Readable say "servant".

decisions.choice: "раб" (L, B); "слуга" (R), as in Matthew 26:51
decisions.reason: The brief keeps "раб" for doulos; Matthew's parallel has "раб" at Literal and Balanced and "слуга" at Readable, where only his service in the household matters.

decisions.choice: "奴隷" (L); "しもべ" (B, R); also 18:10 s2
decisions.reason: The brief's rule for doulos: Literal says slave, Balanced and Readable servant, as the English does. The man belongs to the high priest's household (m2).

decisions.choice: "عبد" (L), "خادم" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The high priest's slave is a slave of Caiaphas's household (m2). Literal keeps "slave"; Balanced and Readable say "servant", as elsewhere in this translation.

decisions.choice: "برده" (Literal); "خادم" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The style brief's split for slave.

decisions.choice: "ਦਾਸ" (every level)

decisions.choice: Malchus: a name used in the region in that period
decisions.reason: The name is found in the region in that period, among Nabateans and others, and is related to the Semitic word for "king". John alone gives it, and he refers to the man again in 18:26, where a relative of his speaks to Peter. Such details suggest that the writer knew the high priest's household (18:15-16).

en.L: So Jesus said to Peter, "Put the sword into the sheath. The cup which the Father has given {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, shall I not drink it?"
en.B: Then Jesus told Peter, "Put your sword back in its sheath! Am I not to drink the cup that the Father has given {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}?"
en.R: Jesus told Peter, "Put your sword away! The Father has given {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} a cup of suffering to drink, and I will drink it."

alignments.target_span: 飲まずにおくことがあろうか

decisions.choice: shall I not drink it?: a question that expects "yes, I will"
alternatives: a real question, asking whether he should
decisions.reason: Greek uses two negatives together for the strongest denial; in a question they expect the answer "yes": of course he will drink it. Jesus is not weighing the choice. He has said his soul is troubled, yet he will not ask to be saved from this hour, for he came for it (12:27).

decisions.choice: the cup: the suffering and death the Father has given him; it may also recall the cup of God's judgment
alternatives: only the cup of suffering, with no thought of judgment
the cup of God's judgment as the main sense
decisions.reason: In the Scriptures a cup that God gives to drink can stand for what he appoints for a person, and often for his judgment (Psalm 75:9; Isaiah 51:17, 22; Jeremiah 25:15). In the other Gospels Jesus prays in the garden, "remove this cup from me; yet not what I will, but what you will" (Mark 14:36), and asks his disciples whether they can drink the cup he drinks (Mark 10:38). Here the cup is the suffering and death ahead of him. Whether John also means the cup of judgment, borne for others, he does not say. Marked uncertain on that point.

decisions.choice: the cup the Father has given me: Jesus receives his death from his Father, and Peter's sword stands in the way of it
decisions.reason: Jesus calls God "the Father" and speaks of his death as the Father's gift, using the same verb as in verse 9. Peter would fight to stop the arrest; Jesus will tell Pilate that his servants do not fight, because his kingdom is not from this world (18:36). The order to put the sword away is not only a rebuke but a choice to go the way the Father has given.

decisions.choice: your sword, its sheath (B); Put your sword away (R)
decisions.reason: Greek uses "the" where English says "your" and "its". Readable says simply "away".

decisions.choice: a cup of suffering; and I will drink it (a statement)
alternatives: the cup ... shall I not drink it? (Literal, Balanced)
decisions.reason: Readable says what the cup stands for, keeping to the part that is certain (meaning decision m2), and turns the question into the statement it expects (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: tu espada, su vaina (B); Guarda tu espada (R); ¿Acaso no ...? (B)
decisions.reason: Spanish uses the possessive where the Greek has the article. "¿Acaso no ...?" gives the question that expects "yes" (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: una copa de sufrimiento; y la voy a beber (a statement)
decisions.reason: As in English: Readable says what the cup stands for, keeping to the part that is certain (meaning decision m2), and turns the question into the statement it expects (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: a rhetorical question "飲まないことがあろうか" (L), "飲まずにおくことがあろうか" (B); a statement "わたしはそれを飲むのだ" (R)
decisions.reason: The double negative expects the answer "yes, I will drink it" (m1). The 〜ことがあろうか question carries that at Literal and Balanced; Readable turns it into the statement, as the English Readable does, and names the cup as suffering.

decisions.choice: a question: "أفلا أشربها؟" (L), "أما أشرب ...؟" (B)
decisions.reason: The question expects "yes, I will" (m1). Readable turns it into the statement it implies.

decisions.choice: "كأس الآلام"
decisions.reason: The cup is the suffering and death the Father has given him (m2); Readable says so.

source.text: Ἡ οὖν σπεῖρα καὶ ὁ χιλίαρχος καὶ οἱ ὑπηρέται τῶν Ἰουδαίων συνέλαβον τὸν Ἰησοῦν καὶ ἔδησαν αὐτὸν καὶ ἤγαγον πρὸς Ἅνναν πρῶτον· ἦν γὰρ πενθερὸς τοῦ Καϊάφα, ὃς ἦν ἀρχιερεὺς τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ ἐκείνου·

records.literal_gloss: The therefore cohort and the commander-of-a-thousand and the officers of the Jews seized the Jesus and bound him, \v 13 and led [him] to Annas first; was for father-in-law of the Caiaphas, who was high priest of the year that;

en.L: So the cohort and the commander and the officers of the Jews seized Jesus and bound {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \v 13 and they led [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}] to Annas first; for he was father-in-law of Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.
en.B: Then the detachment of soldiers with its commander, and the temple police sent by the Jewish leaders, arrested Jesus and tied {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} up. \v 13 They took {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} first to Annas, the father-in-law of Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.
en.R: Then the Roman soldiers and their commander, together with the temple guards of the Jewish leaders, arrested Jesus. They tied {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} up \v 13 and took {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} first to Annas. Annas was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, who was the high priest that year.

es.L: La cohorte, pues, y el comandante y los alguaciles de los judíos prendieron a Jesús y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} ataron, \v 13 y [{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}] llevaron primero a Anás; porque era suegro de Caifás, que era sumo sacerdote aquel año.
es.B: Entonces el destacamento de soldados con su comandante, y los guardias del templo enviados por los dirigentes judíos, arrestaron a Jesús y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} ataron. \v 13 Primero {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} llevaron ante Anás, el suegro de Caifás, que era sumo sacerdote aquel año.
es.R: Entonces los soldados romanos y su comandante, junto con los guardias del templo de los dirigentes judíos, arrestaron a Jesús. Lo ataron \v 13 y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} llevaron primero ante Anás. Anás era el suegro de Caifás, que era el sumo sacerdote aquel año.

fr.L: La cohorte donc, et le commandant, et les gardes des Juifs saisirent Jésus et {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} lièrent, \v 13 et ils [{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}] conduisirent d’abord chez Anne ; car il était le beau-père de Caïphe, qui était grand prêtre cette année-là.
fr.B: Alors le détachement de soldats et son commandant, avec les gardes du temple envoyés par les chefs juifs, arrêtèrent Jésus et {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} ligotèrent. \v 13 Ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}emmenèrent d’abord chez Anne, le beau-père de Caïphe, qui était grand prêtre cette année-là.
fr.R: Alors les soldats romains et leur commandant, avec les gardes du temple des chefs juifs, ont arrêté Jésus. Ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ont ligoté \v 13 et {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ont emmené d’abord chez Anne. Anne était le beau-père de Caïphe, qui était le grand prêtre cette année-là.

sw.L: Basi kikosi, pamoja na kamanda na walinzi wa Wayahudi, walimshika Yesu na kumfunga, \v 13 na kumpeleka kwa Anasi kwanza; kwa sababu huyo alikuwa baba mkwe wa Kayafa, ambaye alikuwa kuhani mkuu mwaka ule.
sw.B: Kisha kikosi cha askari pamoja na kamanda wake, na walinzi wa hekalu waliotumwa na viongozi wa Wayahudi, walimkamata Yesu na kumfunga kamba. \v 13 Walimpeleka kwanza kwa Anasi, baba mkwe wa Kayafa, aliyekuwa kuhani mkuu mwaka ule.
sw.R: Kisha askari wa Kirumi na kamanda wao, pamoja na walinzi wa hekalu wa viongozi wa Wayahudi, walimkamata Yesu. Wakamfunga kamba \v 13 wakampeleka kwanza kwa Anasi. Anasi alikuwa baba mkwe wa Kayafa, aliyekuwa kuhani mkuu mwaka ule.

vi.L: Vậy đội quân, viên chỉ huy nghìn quân và các cảnh vệ của người Do Thái bắt Đức Giê-xu và trói {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại, \v 13 và giải [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}] đến An-ne trước; vì ông là cha vợ của Cai-phe, người làm thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm năm ấy.
vi.B: Bấy giờ toán lính cùng viên chỉ huy và lính canh đền thờ của các nhà lãnh đạo Do Thái bắt Đức Giê-xu và trói {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại. \v 13 Họ giải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến An-ne trước, là cha vợ của Cai-phe, thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm năm ấy.
vi.R: Bấy giờ toán lính La Mã và viên chỉ huy của họ, cùng với lính canh đền thờ của các nhà lãnh đạo Do Thái, bắt Đức Giê-xu. Họ trói {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại \v 13 và giải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến An-ne trước. An-ne là cha vợ của Cai-phe, thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm năm ấy.

ko.L: 그래서 부대와 천부장과 유대인들의 경비병들이 예수를 붙잡아 결박하고, \v 13 먼저 안나스에게로 [그분을] 끌고 갔다. 그는 그해의 대제사장인 가야바의 장인이었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그러자 로마 군인들과 그 지휘관과 유대 지도자들이 보낸 성전 경비병들이 예수를 체포하여 묶었다. \v 13 그리고 그분을 먼저 안나스에게 끌고 갔다. 안나스는 그해의 대제사장인 가야바의 장인이었다.
ko.R: 그러자 로마 군인들과 그 지휘관과 유대 지도자들의 성전 경비병들이 예수님을 붙잡아 묶었다. \v 13 그리고 먼저 안나스에게 끌고 갔다. 안나스는 그해에 대제사장이던 가야바의 장인이었다.

pt.L: A coorte, então, e o comandante e os guardas dos judeus prenderam Jesus e {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} amarraram, \v 13 e [{{deity_pronoun:o|O}}] levaram primeiro a Anás; pois ele era sogro de Caifás, que era sumo sacerdote naquele ano.
pt.B: Então o destacamento de soldados com o seu comandante e a guarda do templo enviada pelos líderes judeus prenderam Jesus e {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} amarraram. \v 13 Primeiro {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} levaram a Anás, sogro de Caifás, que era o sumo sacerdote naquele ano.
pt.R: Então os soldados romanos e o seu comandante, junto com os guardas do templo dos líderes judeus, prenderam Jesus. Eles {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} amarraram \v 13 e {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} levaram primeiro a Anás. Anás era o sogro de Caifás, que era o sumo sacerdote naquele ano.

am.L: ስለዚህ ጭፍራውና የሺ አለቃው የአይሁድም ዘበኞች ኢየሱስን ያዙት፤ አሠሩትም፤ \v 13 አስቀድመውም ወደ ሐና ወሰዱት፤ በዚያ ዓመት ሊቀ ካህናት የነበረው የቀያፋ አማች ነበርና።
am.B: ከዚያም የወታደሮቹ ጭፍራና አዛዣቸው፣ የአይሁድ መሪዎች የላኳቸው የቤተ መቅደስ ዘበኞችም ኢየሱስን ይዘው አሠሩት። \v 13 በመጀመሪያም ወደ ሐና ወሰዱት፤ እርሱም በዚያ ዓመት ሊቀ ካህናት የነበረው የቀያፋ አማች ነበር።
am.R: ከዚያም የሮማውያን ወታደሮችና አዛዣቸው ከአይሁድ መሪዎች የቤተ መቅደስ ጠባቂዎች ጋር ሆነው ኢየሱስን ያዙት። አሠሩትም፤ \v 13 በመጀመሪያም ወደ ሐና ወሰዱት። ሐና በዚያ ዓመት ሊቀ ካህናት የነበረው የቀያፋ አማች ነበር።

hi.L: तब टुकड़ी और सहस्रपति और यहूदियों के पहरेदारों ने यीशु को पकड़ लिया और उन्हें बाँध लिया, \v 13 और [वे] उन्हें पहले हन्ना के पास ले गए; क्योंकि वह कैफ़ा का ससुर था, जो उस वर्ष का महायाजक था।
hi.B: तब सैनिकों की टुकड़ी, उसके सेनापति और यहूदी अगुवों के भेजे हुए मन्दिर के पहरेदारों ने यीशु को गिरफ़्तार कर लिया और उन्हें बाँध दिया। \v 13 वे उन्हें पहले हन्ना के पास ले गए, जो कैफ़ा का ससुर था; कैफ़ा उस वर्ष महायाजक था।
hi.R: तब रोमी सैनिकों और उनके सेनापति ने, यहूदी अगुवों के मन्दिर के पहरेदारों के साथ मिलकर, यीशु को गिरफ़्तार कर लिया। उन्होंने उन्हें बाँध दिया \v 13 और पहले हन्ना के पास ले गए। हन्ना कैफ़ा का ससुर था, और कैफ़ा उस साल महायाजक था।

ru.L: Тогда когорта, и тысяченачальник, и служители иудеев схватили Иисуса и связали {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, \v 13 и отвели [{{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}] сначала к Анне, ведь он был тестем Каиафы, который был первосвященником в тот год.
ru.B: Тогда отряд солдат со своим командиром и храмовая стража иудейских властей арестовали Иисуса и связали {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}. \v 13 Сначала {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} привели к Анне, тестю Каиафы, который был первосвященником в тот год.
ru.R: Тогда римские солдаты и их командир вместе с храмовыми стражниками иудейских вождей арестовали Иисуса. Они связали {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} \v 13 и привели сначала к Анне. Анна был тестем Каиафы, который в тот год был первосвященником.

uk.L: Тож когорта, і тисяцький, і прислужники юдеїв схопили Ісуса і звʼязали {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}, \v 13 і повели [{{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}] спершу до Анни; бо він був тестем Каяфи, який був первосвящеником того року.
uk.B: Тоді загін воїнів зі своїм командиром і храмові вартові, послані юдейською владою, заарештували Ісуса й звʼязали {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}. \v 13 Вони повели {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} спершу до Анни, тестя Каяфи, який був первосвящеником того року.
uk.R: Тоді римські воїни та їхній командир разом із храмовими вартовими юдейських провідників заарештували Ісуса. Вони звʼязали {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} \v 13 і повели спершу до Анни. Анна був тестем Каяфи, який того року був первосвящеником.

ja.L: それで、部隊と千人隊長とユダヤ人たちの下役たちは、イエスを捕らえて縛り、\v 13 まずアンナスのところへ連れて行った。彼はその年の大祭司であったカイアファのしゅうとだったからである。
ja.B: そこで、ローマ兵の一隊とその隊長、そしてユダヤ人の指導者たちが差し向けた神殿の警備兵たちは、イエスを捕らえて縛り、\v 13 まずアンナスのところへ連れて行った。アンナスは、その年の大祭司カイアファのしゅうとであった。
ja.R: そこで、ローマの兵士たちとその隊長、それにユダヤ人の指導者たちに仕える神殿の警備兵たちは、イエスを捕まえて縛り、\v 13 まずアンナスのところへ連れて行きました。アンナスは、その年に大祭司だったカイアファのしゅうとでした。

id.L: Lalu pasukan prajurit itu dan kepala pasukannya dan penjaga-penjaga orang Yahudi menangkap Yesus dan mengikat {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}}, \v 13 lalu membawa [{{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}}] mula-mula kepada Hanas, sebab ia adalah mertua Kayafas, yang menjadi imam besar pada tahun itu;
id.B: Lalu pasukan prajurit itu bersama komandannya, dan penjaga-penjaga Bait Allah yang diutus para pemimpin Yahudi, menangkap Yesus dan mengikat {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}}. \v 13 Mereka membawa {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} mula-mula kepada Hanas, mertua Kayafas, yang menjadi imam besar pada tahun itu.
id.R: Lalu prajurit-prajurit Romawi dan komandan mereka, bersama penjaga-penjaga Bait Allah dari para pemimpin Yahudi, menangkap Yesus. Mereka mengikat {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} \v 13 dan membawa-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} lebih dulu kepada Hanas. Hanas adalah mertua Kayafas, imam besar pada tahun itu.

zh.L: 于是那营队和千夫长，以及犹太人的卫兵，拘捕了耶稣，把{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}捆绑起来，\v 13 先带[{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}]到亚那那里；因为他是该亚法的岳父，该亚法是那一年的大祭司。
zh.B: 于是那队士兵和他们的指挥官，以及犹太领袖派来的圣殿警卫，逮捕了耶稣，把{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}捆绑起来。\v 13 他们先把{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}带到亚那那里。亚那是该亚法的岳父，该亚法是那一年的大祭司。
zh.R: 于是那些罗马士兵和他们的指挥官，还有犹太领袖手下的圣殿卫兵，逮捕了耶稣。他们把{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}绑起来，\v 13 先带{{deity_pronoun:他|祂}}去见亚那。亚那是该亚法的岳父，该亚法是那一年的大祭司。

ar.L: فالكتيبة والقائد وخدّام اليهود قبضوا على يسوع وقيّدوه، \v 13 واقتادوه أوّلًا إلى حنّان، إذ كان حما قيافا، الذي كان رئيس الكهنة في تلك السنة.
ar.B: فقبضت فرقة الجنود مع قائدها، ومعهم حرّاس الهيكل الذين أرسلهم قادة اليهود، على يسوع وقيّدوه. \v 13 وساقوه أوّلًا إلى حنّان، حمي قيافا، الذي كان رئيس الكهنة في تلك السنة.
ar.R: وعندها قبض الجنود الرومان وقائدهم، ومعهم حرّاس الهيكل التابعون لقادة اليهود، على يسوع. وربطوه \v 13 وأخذوه أوّلًا إلى حنّان. وكان حنّان حمي قيافا، الذي كان رئيس الكهنة في تلك السنة.

fa.L: پس آن دسته و فرمانده و مأموران یهودیان عیسی را گرفتند و او را بستند، \v 13 و نخست نزد حنا بردند؛ زیرا او پدرزن قیافا بود، که در آن سال کاهن اعظم بود.
fa.B: آن‌گاه دستهٔ سربازان با فرمانده‌شان، و نگهبانان معبد که سران یهود فرستاده بودند، عیسی را دستگیر کردند و او را بستند. \v 13 او را نخست نزد حنا بردند، پدرزن قیافا، که در آن سال کاهن اعظم بود.
fa.R: آن‌گاه سربازان رومی و فرمانده‌شان، همراه نگهبانان معبد که از سوی سران یهود بودند، عیسی را دستگیر کردند. او را بستند \v 13 و نخست نزد حنا بردند. حنا پدرزن قیافا بود، که در آن سال کاهن اعظم بود.

pa.L: ਤਦ ਪਲਟਨ ਅਤੇ ਪਲਟਨ ਦੇ ਸਰਦਾਰ ਅਤੇ ਯਹੂਦੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਸਿਪਾਹੀਆਂ ਨੇ ਯਿਸੂ ਨੂੰ ਫੜ ਲਿਆ ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਬੰਨ੍ਹ ਲਿਆ, \v 13 ਅਤੇ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਹੰਨਾ ਕੋਲ ਲੈ ਗਏ; ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਉਹ ਕਯਾਫ਼ਾ ਦਾ ਸਹੁਰਾ ਸੀ, ਜਿਹੜਾ ਉਸ ਸਾਲ ਮਹਾਂ ਜਾਜਕ ਸੀ।
pa.B: ਤਦ ਸਿਪਾਹੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਟੁਕੜੀ ਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਪਲਟਨ ਦੇ ਸਰਦਾਰ ਸਮੇਤ, ਅਤੇ ਯਹੂਦੀ ਆਗੂਆਂ ਦੇ ਭੇਜੇ ਹੋਏ ਹੈਕਲ ਦੇ ਪਹਿਰੇਦਾਰਾਂ ਨੇ, ਯਿਸੂ ਨੂੰ ਗਿਰਫ਼ਤਾਰ ਕਰਕੇ ਬੰਨ੍ਹ ਦਿੱਤਾ। \v 13 ਉਹ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਹੰਨਾ ਦੇ ਕੋਲ ਲੈ ਗਏ। ਹੰਨਾ ਕਯਾਫ਼ਾ ਦਾ ਸਹੁਰਾ ਸੀ, ਅਤੇ ਕਯਾਫ਼ਾ ਉਸ ਸਾਲ ਮਹਾਂ ਜਾਜਕ ਸੀ।
pa.R: ਤਦ ਰੋਮੀ ਸਿਪਾਹੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਫ਼ੌਜੀ ਸਰਦਾਰ ਨੇ, ਯਹੂਦੀ ਆਗੂਆਂ ਦੇ ਹੈਕਲ ਦੇ ਪਹਿਰੇਦਾਰਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਰਲ ਕੇ, ਯਿਸੂ ਨੂੰ ਫੜ ਲਿਆ। ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਯਿਸੂ ਨੂੰ ਬੰਨ੍ਹਿਆ \v 13 ਅਤੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਹੰਨਾ ਕੋਲ ਲੈ ਗਏ। ਹੰਨਾ ਕਯਾਫ਼ਾ ਦਾ ਸਹੁਰਾ ਸੀ, ਅਤੇ ਕਯਾਫ਼ਾ ਉਸ ਸਾਲ ਮਹਾਂ ਜਾਜਕ ਸੀ।

alignments.target_span: ユダヤ人の指導者たち

decisions.choice: the cohort and the commander: Roman soldiers under their tribune
alternatives: the commander of the temple guard
decisions.reason: The word χιλίαρχος means "commander of a thousand". It was the Greek name for a Roman tribune, the officer over a cohort, and Acts uses it of the tribune of the Roman garrison in Jerusalem (Acts 21:31-33; 22:24). With "the cohort" (meaning decision m1 at verse 3) it shows that Roman soldiers took part in the arrest along with the temple police.

decisions.choice: the officers of the Jews: the temple police of the Jewish authorities
decisions.reason: These are the officers sent by the chief priests and the Pharisees (verse 3; 7:32, 45). "Of the Jews" names the Jewish authorities they served, set beside the Roman soldiers and their commander. It does not mean the Jewish people as a whole: Jesus and his disciples are Jews.

decisions.choice: Annas first: the former high priest, still powerful through his family, questioned Jesus before Caiaphas did
decisions.reason: Annas was high priest from AD 6 to 15, when the Romans removed him. The historian Josephus records that five of his sons held the office after him, and Caiaphas, the high priest in this year, was his son-in-law. Luke and Acts still call him high priest alongside Caiaphas (Luke 3:2; Acts 4:6). "First" looks ahead: after questioning Jesus, Annas sends him to Caiaphas (18:24).

decisions.choice: high priest that year: the year of Jesus's death
alternatives: the office changed hands every year
decisions.reason: As in 11:49 and 11:51 (meaning decision m1 at 11:49): Caiaphas held the office for many years, and "that year" marks the year in which Jesus died.

decisions.choice: seized and bound him: arrested him as a prisoner
decisions.reason: The first verb is the ordinary word for arresting someone; the second is "tie up". Jesus is led away bound, and Annas later sends him to Caiaphas still bound (18:24).

decisions.choice: the Jewish leaders
decisions.reason: Where the word means the authorities, Balanced and Readable name them (see the book's terms and meaning decision m2). The footnote gives the word John wrote.

decisions.choice: the cohort, the commander, the officers (L); the detachment of soldiers, its commander, the temple police (B); the Roman soldiers, their commander, the temple guards (R)
decisions.reason: As in verse 3 (rendering decision r-en-2 there). Every level says "commander", which is what the title meant; "tribune" is the Roman name for the rank (meaning decision m1). Readable breaks the long sentence, ending the first part after "arrested Jesus" so that verse 13 begins at "and took him".

decisions.choice: los judíos (L); los dirigentes judíos (B, R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide choice for John, as at 1:19: Literal shows the word John wrote; Balanced and Readable name the authorities the context shows (meaning decision m2), so no reader takes it as the whole Jewish people.

decisions.choice: la cohorte, el comandante, los alguaciles (L); el destacamento de soldados, su comandante, los guardias del templo (B); los soldados romanos, su comandante, los guardias del templo (R)
decisions.reason: As in verse 3. Every level says "comandante", which is what the title meant; "tribuno" is the Roman name for the rank (meaning decision m1). "Prendieron" (L) and "arrestaron" (B, R) are the verbs of 7:32.

decisions.choice: les gardes des Juifs (L); les gardes du temple envoyés par les chefs juifs (B); les gardes du temple des chefs juifs (R); aux chefs juifs (B, R) in verse 14
decisions.reason: The book-wide choice for John: Literal keeps the word John wrote, and Balanced and Readable name the authorities the officers served (meaning decision m2), since French "les Juifs" alone reads as the whole people. Jesus and his disciples are Jews. In verse 14 the word means the members of the council, and Balanced and Readable say "les chefs juifs" there too.

decisions.choice: Wayahudi (L); viongozi wa Wayahudi (B, R)

decisions.choice: the Jews: the members of the council, the chief priests and the Pharisees
decisions.reason: John points back to the meeting of the council in 11:47-53, where Caiaphas spoke to the chief priests and Pharisees gathered there. These are the authorities, not the people as a whole.

decisions.choice: John reminds the reader of Caiaphas's advice in 11:49-52: the man before whom Jesus will stand has already decided that he must die
decisions.reason: The words repeat 11:50 almost exactly, without "for you". Caiaphas meant a political calculation: one man's death to spare the nation. John has said that, as high priest that year, he prophesied without knowing it that Jesus would die for the nation and for the scattered children of God (11:51-52). The outcome of the questioning that follows is already settled.

decisions.choice: it is better ... for the people: to their advantage; on their behalf and in their place
decisions.reason: The verb means "it is profitable" or "it is to someone's advantage", as in 11:50. "For" means on behalf of, and here also instead of (meaning decision m3 at 11:50).

decisions.choice: the Jewish leaders
decisions.reason: Where the word means the authorities, Balanced and Readable name them (see the book's terms and meaning decision m1). The footnote gives the word John wrote.

decisions.choice: it is better (L); it would be better (B); it would be best to let (R); one man ... die for the people (every level)
alternatives: it is to your advantage (as at 11:50)
decisions.reason: Every level keeps "one man" and "die for the people", the words of 11:50, so that the reader hears the echo. Here the Greek has no "for you", so "better" gives the sense of advantage plainly. Balanced and Readable use "would be", as English does in reported advice; Literal keeps the present tense of the original words.

decisions.choice: conviene (L), convenía (B), era mejor (R); un hombre muera por el pueblo
